Impact in 2025

This is what your generosity made possible

1.2 Million people fed through food distributions worldwide

1,267,655 people reached with emergency relief

24,821 students empowered through education initiatives globally

111,000+ individuals supported through healthcare programs

467,000 people provided with clean water access

28,170 individuals supported through local programs right here in Canada

These are not statistics. They are people, each one with a name, a family, and a story that changed because of your generosity.

Change the World: Urgent Needs

Changing Lives Through Compassion: Human Concern International

Food Aid

Food security is fundamental to human dignity. Through monthly food programs and emergency distributions, HCI fights hunger on the frontlines, ensuring vulnerable communities have the nutrition they need to survive and thrive.
Donate Now
Learn More

Water Aid

Access to clean water and healthcare transforms lives. HCI’s WASH (Water, Sanitation, and Hygiene) initiatives provide safe drinking water and hygiene education, while our health programs deliver crucial medical care and supplies to underserved communities.
Donate Now
Learn More

Child Sponsorship

Education empowers brighter futures. Through our Child Sponsorship Program, donors help children access schools, healthcare, nutritious food, and safe environments, offering hope and opportunity to the next generation.
Donate Now

Save lives

Your Concern Can Put Food on Their Table

Compassion reminds us of our shared humanity and our responsibility toward one another. While many of us are able to meet our daily needs, millions of families around the world face uncertainty about their next meal. This reality calls us to reflect not just on our own blessings, but on how we can uplift those who are struggling.

When we allow empathy to guide our actions, we can help restore dignity, provide nourishment, and offer hope to families facing hardship. Your generosity has the power to turn concern into meaningful support for those who need it most.

Your compassion can restore dignity, provide nourishment, and deliver hope when it is needed most.

Give your Zakat. Feed a family

How Your Giving Helps

Your donations support critical programs, including:

Food Assistance Programs

Providing nutritious meals to families facing hunger and food insecurity.

Zakat Distribution

Distributed responsibly to eligible recipients, ensuring your support reaches those most in need.

Emergency Relief

Delivering urgent aid including food, water, shelter, and medical care to crisis-affected communities.

Orphan & Child Sponsorship

Supporting vulnerable children with education, healthcare, and stability.

Clean Water & Healthcare

Offering sustainable solutions that protect health and restore dignity.

Empowering Change Globally

For 46 years, donors have trusted us to deliver aid with dignity

  • 46 years of humanitarian service
  • Operating in 16 countries worldwide
  • Committed to transparency, accountability, and impact


We don’t just provide aid. We stand with communities through their most difficult moments.

Give With Purpose

Your generosity can feed the hungry, comfort the displaced, and bring relief to those who are struggling to survive.

Allah calls us to give with trust and sincerity:
“The example of those who spend their wealth in the way of Allah is like a seed that grows seven ears; in every ear is a hundred grains.”
(Qur’an 2:261)
